thread:
Sam: Heads-up from AE: a prospect wants a marketplace PoC that includes a $20k hardware credit from Dell. How do we wire that into a private offer without double-billing?
Priya: We should create a separate line item for partner_hardware_credit and mark it as non-taxable. Marketplace returns often can't do complex offsets so we rely on internal ledger offsets.
Zoey: +1. Suggest flow: PoC SKU -> on-convert create draft private offer with 2 line items (usage, hw_credit). Include a hw_verification_required flag.
Marcus: Ops caveat: some marketplaces bill the customer immediately on SKU purchase. If HW credit is contingent, we need to issue an internal credit memo post-verification, not a refund.
Sam: Can we surface the HW verification status in the console PO view so Partner AE sees pending vs applied?
PartnerBot: UI widget created: PO details now include partner_credit status. Link: https://console.redwood.example/po/4567/status
Priya: For contract language, require partner serials claimed in 60 days. If serials absent, credits lapse and a notification email goes to customer + SI. Legal thumbs-up pending.
Zoey: Field playbook: when customer clicks "Convert to Commit" -> create PO draft, send verification checklist to SI (serials, installation photo, SI contact). Mark a 14-day SLA for SI response.
Marcus: Billing design: when PO accepted, generate proforma with placeholder credit. If serials verified later, attach a credit note and apply as invoice offset on next billing cycle. If marketplace already charged and overpayment occurs, internal offset only.
Sam: Partner AE asked about discount guarantees on renewal. Proposed: 12-month commit gets 12% off list, plus partner credit zeroes out first month. For multi-year offer, taper discounts: 12%, 8% year2.
Priya: We should avoid hard-locked multi-year percentages in marketplace metadata; instead keep discounts in private offer terms so we can change post-sign. Marketplaces show effective price but not complex ladders.
Zoey: Also propose a joint announcement checklist for co-marketing: timeline, NDA confirmation, logo usage, and single quote approval. Put that into PO metadata as marketing_flag = true.
Marcus: Telemetry needed: track events: sku_purchase_ts, convert_click_ts, po_draft_created_ts, po_accepted_ts, hw_serials_claimed_ts, credit_applied_ts. Weekly reconciler must emit mismatches to #finance-alerts.
Sam: Edge-case: SI delivers hardware late but customer already consumed usage. We should not claw back usage; credits are goodwill. Legal to draft language about non-recoverable credits post-application.
Priya: Ops action items: 1) tag SKU templates for partner credits, 2) create internal credit memo flow, 3) add hw_verification UI state. Marcus to own reconciler.
Zoey: I'll own the onboarding checklist and marketing_flag flow. Will add sample email templates for SI verification.
Marcus: I'll draft the weekly reconciler lambda and a sample DB schema for credit_memos, mapping to meter_id and po_id.
PartnerBot: Draft PO created -> PO-4567 (draft). Notifications sent to AE and SI.
Sam: Thanks team. Target: ship prototype flow to staging by next Tues. Quick sync Weds morning if needed. :rocket:
